name: Kauai Healing Massage
imageAlt: Kauai Healing Massage website shown on a desktop display
body: Kauai Healing Massage, led by seasoned therapist Katie, needed a modern, client-friendly website to reflect the premium, personalized care she offers to both locals and high-end visitors on the island of Kauai. Despite her exceptional skillset and loyal client base, she lacked a strong online presence and an effective way to attract and manage new appointments.

We built a clean, elegant website under a powerful domain name that speaks directly to her brand and services. The site highlights her healing philosophy, experience, and full range of therapeutic massage services — while making it easy for clients to connect and book directly.

Since launch, Katie has remained consistently booked thanks to strategic ad placement and a site that converts visits into appointments. Her practice now thrives with minimal downtime, and she’s grown her high-end clientele on the island — all while maintaining the personal, soulful care she’s known for.
result: Calls increased by 45% in the first 60 days.

highlights.title: Custom Website Design
highlights.text: A beautiful, fast-loading, and mobile-friendly site that reflects the calm, restorative nature of her practice.

highlights.title: Smart Booking Flow
highlights.text: Clear calls-to-action and simple mobile-first contact methods that make it frictionless for clients to reach out or schedule.

highlights.title: Google Ads Management
highlights.text: We launched and now actively manage targeted Google Ads campaigns, resulting in consistent client bookings from both tourists and residents.

highlights.title: Brand Positioning
highlights.text: From copy to structure, the site positions Katie as a trusted, high-end mobile massage therapist with deep roots in holistic healing and Ayurvedic practices.
